summary: Louisa discusses the events of Parashat Vayigash, focusing on Yosef's reaction to his brothers. She explores why Yosef chose to show kindness rather than seek revenge after his brothers demonstrated that they had changed.
questions: Why did Yosef choose to be kind to his brothers?
How did the brothers show they had changed?
What should you do when someone who wronged you feels bad about it?
Why should you repay someone with kindness even if they hurt you?
